text_block_list.text:
Our three years together with Katsuragi Ace came to an end,
and a little time passed—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four, and...
Hey! You stylish rebel over there!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be... me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Come hang out with me for a bit!
2400 meters, counterclockwise!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You were, let's see...――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City.
The dancing fool from across the sea.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, who cares about me.
Are you gonna do it? Or not?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...2,400 meters, counter-clockwise, right?
Sounds good to me."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I just gotta knock 'em flat out, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, show me!
Show me your run...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha!! Awesome...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So this is Katsuragi Ace...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...—
Thanks...! That was a wicked run—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing too.
I never expected you'd contest the lead like that~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: From here on out... what are you aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Where am I aiming for?
Hmm...—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ……I got no clue.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: For real? Haha!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't know for sure, but...
I definitely intend to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pushing forward until the moment I collapseâ
I think that's the one thing that will never change.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Forward until you drop, huh? Cool!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Ace of Japan!
What an utterly insane way of living!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I-Is that supposed to be a compliment...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm praising you.
—Enough to cross an entire ocean, even!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Bye! Katsuragi Ace!!
May the light of romance shine upon your course ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —...She's an interesting one, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow...
I feel like she's gonna do something huge someday—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —...and so, that's what happened just a while ago.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Man, nobody's ever really challenged me out of the blue like that before, so it felt like something straight out of a manga! Super fun!
choice_data_list: If anything, you're usually the one picking fights.
If anything, you're usually the one picking fights.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, totally! Man, you really get it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just like I told her, I really have no clue
where I'm heading next from here...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll push as far as I can go,
and where I collapse is...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I want you to see this through with me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Of course, that's what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: Because I'm your Trainer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's keep moving forward today. "Forward"—together!!
